name: Michael Hobbes
notes: Co-host Maintenance Phase podcast + newsletter; independent fact-check journalism and media criticism. Prior: You're Wrong About. Massive following.

name: Garrett M. Graff
notes: Pulitzer finalist journalist and historian. Author of Watergate, Raven Rock, The Only Plane in the Sky. Independent newsletter at doomsdayscenario.co. Formerly Politico Magazine.

name: Wendy Siegelman
notes: Independent investigative journalist covering Trump, kleptocracy, dark money, far-right networks. Heavy OSINT methodology. Newsletter active. Very strong Atlas fit.

name: Jason Koebler
notes: Co-founder 404 Media — independent tech newsroom (worker-owned). Individual face of publication. Covers Big Tech, AI, surveillance. Subscription newsletter model.

name: David M. Perry
notes: Journalist and historian. Runs Modern Medieval Newsletter. Author, former professor. Writes for The Atlantic, CNN, NBC. Independent newsletter is primary platform.

name: Virginia Heffernan
notes: Longtime journalist. Podcast "What Rough Beast." Substack "Magic + Loss." Freelance contributor to Wired, NYT, Politico. Independent voice.

name: Molly Crabapple
notes: Artist and journalist. Substack confirmed in bio. Written for NYT, Vice, Rolling Stone. Covers conflict zones, civil liberties, art as journalism.

name: Karen Hao
notes: Freelance AI journalist. NYT bestseller EMPIRE OF AI. National Magazine Award winner. Formerly MIT Technology Review, WSJ. Independent newsletter/book-driven creator.

name: Melody Schreiber
notes: Contributing editor The New Republic, health reporter Guardian US. Independent health journalism focused on Arctic and maternal health. Newsletter active.

name: Lux Alptraum
notes: Journalist, author, podcaster. Independent. Covers sex, politics, culture, OCD. Has newsletter and podcast. Author of Faking It.

name: Jack Mirkinson
notes: Co-owner/editor Discourse Blog (independent media criticism). Senior editor The Nation. Media beat + independent publication. Strong Atlas fit.

name: Tom Ley
notes: Co-owner Defector Media — worker-owned independent sports newsroom. Individual face/columnist. Ghost platform subscription model. Strong TrustFnd fit.

name: Dan Ozzi
notes: Independent music journalist and author. Books on punk and music scenes. Newsletter at danozzi.com. Freelance for major publications.

name: Kevin Gosztola
notes: Editor of The Dissenter Newsletter (Substack). Covers national security law, press freedom, whistleblowers, WikiLeaks. Independent journalist. Smaller following but strong beat.

name: Tristan Ahtone
notes: Kiowa journalist. Editor-at-large Grist. Covers Indigenous communities, land rights, tribal sovereignty. Rare voice — strong Atlas gap fill. Newsletter status needs verification.

name: Rob Pegoraro
notes: DC-based freelance tech journalist. Covers consumer tech, privacy, telecom. Bylines WaPo, USA Today, Yahoo Tech. Newsletter active at robpegoraro.com. Independent.
